purpose: Activate the existing pair_index/relation path with a query-independent, exact-capability hard-boundary ranking objective while preserving the accepted Field-A raw RADIO, DINOv3, and SAM3 capability.

motivation_evidence_only.interpretation_frozen_before_field_b: Field-A improved node fidelity but did not improve the local relation graph. These already observed results motivate a pairwise objective but did not select a scalar margin, relation weight, k, epoch count, or benchmark-specific rule.

triplet_contract.name: exact_capability_local_hard_boundary_ranking_v1
triplet_contract.neighbor_count_source: the pre-existing global k=16 capability-graph default
triplet_contract.positive_rule: argmax sqrt(dino_affinity * sam3_affinity) within the fixed non-self k16 neighborhood
triplet_contract.hard_negative_rule: argmax geometry * max(sqrt(dino_affinity * (1-sam3_affinity)), sqrt(sam3_affinity * (1-dino_affinity))) after excluding the selected positive
triplet_contract.nonpositive_gap_rule: drop only exact ties/nonpositive gaps and record their full-data fraction
triplet_contract.pair_index_layout: [2,2T], first T anchor-positive columns followed by aligned T anchor-negative columns

pretraining_cpu_acceptance_gate.split_rule: With seed 0 and validation_fraction 0.05, remove every triplet touching any validation row; record the remaining training count and assert no validation endpoint remains.
pretraining_cpu_acceptance_gate.failure_action: Stop before GPU training and report the degeneracy or memory failure. Do not modify margin, weight, or neighbor count from the observed full-data statistics.

loss_contract.relation_weight_source: the pre-existing CanonicalFieldLossConfig global default; not selected from figurines or any benchmark target

training_contract.initialization: continue the immutable accepted Field-A checkpoint without architecture changes
training_contract.triplet_schedule: uniformly shuffle the accepted training-only triplets once per epoch and use every one exactly once

label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.comparison: immutable Field-A checkpoint versus the one registered Field-B checkpoint on the unchanged raw MPR, exact DINOv3 target, exact SAM3 target, and full query-independent triplet cache
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.raw_mean_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.005
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.raw_p05_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.010
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.dino_v3_mean_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.005
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.dino_v3_p05_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.010
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.sam3_mean_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.005
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.sam3_p05_cosine: may not regress by more than 0.010
label_free_gate_before_benchmark_evaluat.failure_action: Reject Field-B and report it before opening any new LERF, SPIn9, or NVOS target evaluation.

estimated_cost_before_execution.full_triplet_cpu_build: approximately 2.5-4 GB host RAM and 3-8 minutes
estimated_cost_before_execution.gpu_training: approximately 6-10 GB GPU memory and 8-15 minutes, potentially 4-7x Field-A step cost due to official DINO/SAM relation projections
estimated_cost_before_execution.thermal_policy: physical GPU1 only, 300.5 W hard limit, 20-second telemetry, start <=78 C, pause >=81 C, resume <=76 C, abort >=84 C
